subject: MorrisJS htmlwidgets chart not displaying in Shiny

messages.author: 7e7cccf3cb79cba5
messages.subject: MorrisJS htmlwidgets chart not displaying in Shiny
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm using the MorrisJS htmlwidgets (see https://github.com/Tutuchan/morrisjs) to generate a donut chart.

It works inside the RStudio Pane and in a markdown document, but the chart does not work in Shiny. Instead of seeing the chart, I'm getting this warning:

Warning in `output$donut`(...) :
Ignoring explicitly provided widget ID "htmlwidget-51a78355f1225af0ba529711a4c29e8f"; Shiny doesn't use them

Any advice on why the chart is not showing and what the warning means? I'm guessing it has something to do with the id on the <div> not matching, and hence the missing chart?

Below is a simple reproducible example of my code and my sessionInfo

Thanks,

Ben

library(shiny)
library(morrisjs)

ui <- basicPage(
  morrisjsOutput("donut")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$donut <- renderMorrisjs({
    morrisjs(list(c("Label 1", "Label 2"), c(10, 20))) %>%
      mjsDonut
})
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
